agent_result:
Setup complete and verified.

**What was configured:**
- Installed `autossh`, `openssh-server`, `supervisor` globally via apt.
- Generated an SSH keypair at `/root/.ssh/id_rsa`, added it to `authorized_keys`, trusted the localhost host key, and confirmed key-based auth to `root@127.0.0.1` (`PermitRootLogin prohibit-password`).
- Started `sshd` (listening on :22).
- Created `/etc/supervisor/conf.d/autossh.conf` running:
  `autossh -M 0 -N -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -i /root/.ssh/id_rsa -R 9000:localhost:22 root@127.0.0.1`
  with `autostart=true`, `autorestart=true`, `startretries=100`.
- Started `supervisord`.

**Verification:**
- Reverse tunnel active: `127.0.0.1:9000` LISTEN (forwarded to sshd).
- End-to-end: `ssh -p 9000 ... root@127.0.0.1` returned `TUNNEL_OK`.
- Failover: killing autossh+children, supervisor restarted it (new pid) and port 9000 came back up.
